synopsis.en: Bear picks apples one by one, one to five, and finds a friend to share with.
synopsis.zh: 小熊一个一个地摘苹果，从一数到五，还找到朋友一起分享。

pages.en: Bear has a big, empty basket.
pages.zh: 小熊有一个空空的大篮子。

pages.en: One red apple. Plop! Into the basket.
pages.zh: 一个红苹果。扑通！放进篮子。

pages.en: Two apples, three apples. Bear counts each one.
pages.zh: 两个苹果，三个苹果。小熊一个一个地数。

pages.en: Four apples, five apples. The basket is full!
pages.zh: 四个苹果，五个苹果。篮子满啦！

pages.en: Yun comes by. "What a lot of apples!"
pages.zh: 小云走过来。“好多苹果呀！”

pages.en: Bear gives Yun one apple. Five apples, shared by two friends.
pages.zh: 小熊送给小云一个苹果。五个苹果，两个好朋友一起分享。

synopsis.en: As night falls, Yun counts the stars that come out, all the way to ten.
synopsis.zh: 天黑了，小云数着一颗颗出来的星星，一直数到十。

pages.en: The sun goes down. The sky turns dark blue.
pages.zh: 太阳落山了。天空变成了深蓝色。

pages.en: One little star comes out. Hello, star!
pages.zh: 一颗小星星出来了。星星你好！

pages.en: Two, three, four. More stars are waking up.
pages.zh: 两颗、三颗、四颗。更多的星星醒来了。

pages.en: Five, six, seven. Yun points to each one.
pages.zh: 五颗、六颗、七颗。小云一颗一颗地指。

pages.en: Eight, nine... where is the last one?
pages.zh: 八颗、九颗……最后一颗在哪里？

pages.en: There, above the lantern! Ten little stars.
pages.zh: 在那里，灯笼的上面！十颗小星星。

pages.en: Good night, ten little stars.
pages.zh: 晚安，十颗小星星。

title.en: One for You, One for Me

synopsis.en: Yun has cookies for every friend: one each, until everyone has one.
synopsis.zh: 小云给每个朋友分饼干，一人一个，直到大家都有。

pages.en: Yun baked four round cookies.
pages.zh: 小云烤了四块圆圆的饼干。

pages.en: Here come Bear, Duck and Frog.
pages.zh: 小熊、鸭子和青蛙来了。

pages.en: One for Bear. One for Duck.
pages.zh: 小熊一块，鸭子一块。

pages.en: One for Frog. And one for Yun!
pages.zh: 青蛙一块，还有小云一块！

pages.en: Four friends, four cookies. Everyone has one.
pages.zh: 四个朋友，四块饼干。每个人都有一块。

pages.en: Crunch, crunch! Sharing tastes good.
pages.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓！一起分享真好吃。

synopsis.en: At the bus stop, Yun lines up riders and seats to see which has more.
synopsis.zh: 在车站，小云把乘客和座位排成一排，看看哪个多。

pages.en: The little bus stops at the station. Beep beep!
pages.zh: 小巴士停在车站。嘀嘀！

pages.en: The bus has four seats.
pages.zh: 巴士上有四个座位。

pages.en: Five friends are waiting to get on.
pages.zh: 有五个朋友在等着上车。

pages.en: One friend, one seat. Yun lines them up.
pages.zh: 一个朋友，一个座位。小云把他们排好。

pages.en: One friend has no seat. There are more friends than seats!
pages.zh: 有一个朋友没有座位。朋友比座位多！

pages.en: Bear waves. "I'll take the next bus. See you soon!"
pages.zh: 小熊挥挥手。“我坐下一班车。一会儿见！”

synopsis.en: It is Duck's birthday! How many candles go on the cake?
synopsis.zh: 今天是鸭子的生日！蛋糕上要插几根蜡烛呢？

pages.en: Today is Duck's birthday!
pages.zh: 今天是鸭子的生日！

pages.en: Yun and Bear bring a big round cake.
pages.zh: 小云和小熊送来一个大大的圆蛋糕。

pages.en: "How old are you, Duck?" "I am four!"
pages.zh: “鸭子，你几岁了？”“我四岁了！”

pages.en: Four candles for four years. One, two, three, four.
pages.zh: 四岁插四根蜡烛。一、二、三、四。

pages.en: The candles glow like little lanterns.
pages.zh: 蜡烛亮亮的，像小灯笼一样。

pages.en: Take a big breath... and blow!
pages.zh: 深深吸一口气……吹！

pages.en: Happy birthday, Duck!
pages.zh: 鸭子，生日快乐！

synopsis.en: In Shape Village, a round house is looking for its round roof.
synopsis.zh: 形状村里，一座圆房子在找它圆圆的屋顶。

pages.en: In Shape Village, every house has a roof.
pages.zh: 形状村里，每座房子都有屋顶。

pages.en: Whoosh! The wind blows the roofs away.
pages.zh: 呼！大风把屋顶吹跑了。

pages.en: The round house looks up. Where is my round roof?
pages.zh: 圆房子抬头看。我的圆屋顶在哪里？

pages.en: A triangle roof floats by. Too pointy!
pages.zh: 一个三角形屋顶飘过来。太尖啦！

pages.en: A square roof floats by. Too flat!
pages.zh: 一个正方形屋顶飘过来。太平啦！

pages.en: Here comes a round roof. It fits just right!
pages.zh: 圆圆的屋顶来了。刚刚好！

pages.en: Round roof, round house. Home again.
pages.zh: 圆屋顶，圆房子。又回家了。

synopsis.en: Yun spots triangles everywhere: mountains, roofs and slices of watermelon.
synopsis.zh: 小云到处都看到三角形：大山、屋顶，还有西瓜片。

pages.en: Yun looks at the big mountain. It has three sides.
pages.zh: 小云看着大山。它有三条边。

pages.en: That is a triangle!
pages.zh: 那是三角形！

pages.en: The roof of Bear's house is a triangle too.
pages.zh: 小熊家的屋顶也是三角形。

pages.en: Yun's slice of watermelon? A triangle!
pages.zh: 小云的西瓜片呢？也是三角形！

pages.en: Duck folds a paper boat. Its sail is a triangle.
pages.zh: 鸭子折了一只纸船。船帆是三角形的。

pages.en: One, two, three corners. Triangles are everywhere!
pages.zh: 一个、两个、三个角。到处都是三角形！

synopsis.en: After the rain, Yun names each colour of the rainbow in two languages.
synopsis.zh: 雨停了，小云用两种语言说出彩虹的每一种颜色。

pages.en: The rain stops. The sun comes out.
pages.zh: 雨停了。太阳出来了。

pages.en: Look up! A rainbow!
pages.zh: 快看天上！一道彩虹！

pages.en: Red is hóng. Orange is chéng.
pages.zh: 红色是 red。橙色是 orange。

pages.en: Yellow is huáng. Green is lǜ.
pages.zh: 黄色是 yellow。绿色是 green。

pages.en: Blue is lán. Purple is zǐ.
pages.zh: 蓝色是 blue。紫色是 purple。

pages.en: One rainbow, and two ways to say every color.
pages.zh: 一道彩虹，每种颜色都有两种说法。

synopsis.en: Yellow and blue swirl together, and something green appears!
synopsis.zh: 黄色和蓝色转呀转，变出了绿色！

pages.en: Yun has three pots of paint: red, yellow and blue.
pages.zh: 小云有三罐颜料：红色、黄色和蓝色。

pages.en: A little yellow, a little blue. Swirl, swirl!
pages.zh: 一点黄色，一点蓝色。转呀转！

pages.en: Look! Now it is green.
pages.zh: 看！变成绿色了。

pages.en: Red and yellow make orange.
pages.zh: 红色和黄色变成橙色。

pages.en: Red and blue make purple.
pages.zh: 红色和蓝色变成紫色。

pages.en: Yun paints a picture with every new color.
pages.zh: 小云用新颜色画了一幅画。

synopsis.en: Seven shapes slide together to make a cat, a boat and a house.
synopsis.zh: 七块图形拼一拼，变成小猫、小船和房子。

pages.en: Grandma has seven flat shapes in a box.
pages.zh: 奶奶的盒子里有七块平平的图形。

pages.en: Two big triangles, and one small square...
pages.zh: 两个大三角形，还有一个小正方形……

pages.en: Slide, turn, slide. What is it?
pages.zh: 推一推，转一转。这是什么？

pages.en: It is a cat with pointy ears!
pages.zh: 是一只尖耳朵的小猫！

pages.en: Mix them up. Now it is a boat.
pages.zh: 打乱再拼。现在是一只小船。

pages.en: Same seven shapes, so many pictures!
pages.zh: 同样的七块图形，能拼出好多图画！

synopsis.en: Yun tries on Bear's big shoes and Mouse's tiny ones.
synopsis.zh: 小云试穿小熊的大鞋子，还有小老鼠的小鞋子。

pages.en: Yun finds Bear's shoes by the door.
pages.zh: 小云在门边看到小熊的鞋子。

pages.en: Yun puts them on. Flop, flop! Too big!
pages.zh: 小云穿上试试。啪嗒啪嗒！太大啦！

pages.en: Mouse's shoes are next to them.
pages.zh: 小老鼠的鞋子就在旁边。

pages.en: Yun tries them. Squeeze! Too small!
pages.zh: 小云再试试。好挤！太小啦！

pages.en: Here are Yun's own shoes. Just right.
pages.zh: 这是小云自己的鞋子。刚刚好。

pages.en: Big shoes, small shoes, and Yun's shoes in the middle.
pages.zh: 大鞋子，小鞋子，小云的鞋子在中间。

synopsis.en: Block by block, the tower grows taller than Yun!
synopsis.zh: 一块一块往上搭，塔比小云还高了！

pages.en: Yun puts one block on the floor.
pages.zh: 小云把一块积木放在地上。

pages.en: One more on top. The tower is short.
pages.zh: 上面再放一块。塔还很矮。

pages.en: More and more blocks. It grows taller.
pages.zh: 积木越来越多。塔越来越高。

pages.en: Now the tower is as tall as Bear's knee.
pages.zh: 现在塔和小熊的膝盖一样高。

pages.en: Wobble, wobble... it stands!
pages.zh: 晃呀晃……它站住了！

pages.en: The tallest tower! Yun is so happy.
pages.zh: 最高的塔！小云好开心。

synopsis.en: Grandma knits a long scarf and a short one. Who gets which?
synopsis.zh: 奶奶织了一条长围巾和一条短围巾。谁戴哪一条呢？

pages.en: Grandma is knitting by the window.
pages.zh: 奶奶坐在窗边织毛线。

pages.en: She makes a long, long scarf.
pages.zh: 她织了一条长长的围巾。

pages.en: Then she makes a short little scarf.
pages.zh: 又织了一条短短的小围巾。

pages.en: The long scarf goes round and round Bear's neck.
pages.zh: 长围巾在小熊的脖子上绕了一圈又一圈。

pages.en: The short scarf fits Mouse just right.
pages.zh: 短围巾给小老鼠刚刚好。

pages.en: Long and short, warm and cozy.
pages.zh: 长的和短的，都暖暖和和。

synopsis.en: A feather and a rock sit on the seesaw. Which side goes down?
synopsis.zh: 羽毛和石头坐上跷跷板。哪一边会往下沉？

pages.en: Yun and Duck find a seesaw in the park.
pages.zh: 小云和鸭子在公园里找到一个跷跷板。

pages.en: Yun puts a feather on one side.
pages.zh: 小云在一边放了一根羽毛。

pages.en: Duck puts a rock on the other side.
pages.zh: 鸭子在另一边放了一块石头。

pages.en: Bump! The rock side goes down.
pages.zh: 咚！石头那边沉下去了。

pages.en: The rock is heavy. The feather is light.
pages.zh: 石头很重。羽毛很轻。

pages.en: What if Bear sits on it? Down he goes!
pages.zh: 要是小熊坐上去呢？一下子就沉下去了！

synopsis.en: The big hat is too big, the small hat too small, and this one is just right.
synopsis.zh: 大帽子太大，小帽子太小，这顶刚刚好。

pages.en: Yun wants a hat for the sunny day.
pages.zh: 晴天到了，小云想戴一顶帽子。

pages.en: The first hat is big. It covers Yun's eyes!
pages.zh: 第一顶帽子好大。把小云的眼睛都遮住了！

pages.en: The second hat is small. It sits on one ear.
pages.zh: 第二顶帽子好小。只能挂在一只耳朵上。

pages.en: The third hat is not big and not small.
pages.zh: 第三顶帽子不大也不小。

pages.en: It is just right!
pages.zh: 刚刚好！

pages.en: Off Yun goes to play in the sun.
pages.zh: 小云戴着帽子去晒太阳玩啦。

synopsis.en: The meadow flowers glow in a pattern. What colour comes next?
synopsis.zh: 草地上的花按规律亮起来。下一朵是什么颜色？

pages.en: Night comes to the Starry Meadow.
pages.zh: 星空原的夜晚来了。

pages.en: The flowers light up one by one.
pages.zh: 花朵一朵一朵亮起来。

pages.en: Red, blue, red, blue...
pages.zh: 红、蓝、红、蓝……

pages.en: Oh! One flower is still dark.
pages.zh: 哎呀！还有一朵没有亮。

pages.en: Red, blue, red... what comes next?
pages.zh: 红、蓝、红……下一朵是什么？

pages.en: Blue! The pattern glows all the way across.
pages.zh: 蓝色！整排花都按规律亮起来了。

synopsis.en: Friends hang lanterns, red, yellow, red, yellow, all along the street.
synopsis.zh: 朋友们在街上挂灯笼，红、黄、红、黄，挂满整条街。

pages.en: Tonight is lantern night on Yun's street.
pages.zh: 今晚是小云家那条街的灯笼夜。

pages.en: Bear hangs a red lantern.
pages.zh: 小熊挂上一个红灯笼。

pages.en: Duck hangs a yellow lantern.
pages.zh: 鸭子挂上一个黄灯笼。

pages.en: Red, yellow, red, yellow, all along the street.
pages.zh: 红、黄、红、黄，挂满整条街。

pages.en: Which color comes next? Red!
pages.zh: 下一个是什么颜色？红色！

pages.en: The whole street glows. Good night, lanterns.
pages.zh: 整条街都亮了。灯笼们，晚安。

synopsis.en: First Yun wakes up, next Yun eats breakfast, last Yun goes out to play.
synopsis.zh: 小云先起床，再吃早饭，最后出去玩。

pages.en: Good morning! First, Yun wakes up and stretches.
pages.zh: 早上好！小云先起床，伸个懒腰。

pages.en: Next, Yun washes and brushes teeth.
pages.zh: 再洗脸、刷牙。

pages.en: Then, breakfast! Warm rice and a little egg.
pages.zh: 然后吃早饭！热乎乎的米饭和一个小鸡蛋。

pages.en: Last, Yun puts on shoes.
pages.zh: 最后，小云穿上鞋子。

pages.en: First, next, then, last. Now it is time to play!
pages.zh: 先、再、然后、最后。现在可以出去玩啦！

pages.en: Out the door Yun goes.
pages.zh: 小云出门啦。

synopsis.en: Bear claps, Frog stomps: clap, stomp, clap, stomp. Can you join in?
synopsis.zh: 小熊拍手，青蛙跺脚：拍、跺、拍、跺。你也来一起吧！

pages.en: Bear has a song. Clap!
pages.zh: 小熊有一首歌。拍！

pages.en: Frog has a song too. Stomp!
pages.zh: 青蛙也有一首歌。跺！

pages.en: Together: clap, stomp, clap, stomp.
pages.zh: 一起来：拍、跺、拍、跺。

pages.en: Duck joins in. Clap, stomp, clap...
pages.zh: 鸭子也来了。拍、跺、拍……

pages.en: What comes next? Stomp!
pages.zh: 下一个是什么？跺！

pages.en: Clap, stomp, clap, stomp. Everyone dances!
pages.zh: 拍、跺、拍、跺。大家一起跳舞！

synopsis.en: A seed, a sprout, a bud, a flower, step by step.
synopsis.zh: 种子、小芽、花苞、花朵，一步一步长大。

pages.en: Yun plants a tiny seed in the dirt.
pages.zh: 小云把一颗小种子种进土里。

pages.en: Sun and rain help it wake up.
pages.zh: 阳光和雨水帮它醒过来。

pages.en: A little green sprout pokes out.
pages.zh: 一棵绿绿的小芽钻出来了。

pages.en: The sprout grows leaves, and then a bud.
pages.zh: 小芽长出叶子，又长出花苞。

pages.en: The bud opens. A flower!
pages.zh: 花苞打开了。是一朵花！

pages.en: Seed, sprout, bud, flower. Step by step.
pages.zh: 种子、小芽、花苞、花朵。一步一步。

synopsis.en: Is Duck in the box, on the box, or under the box?
synopsis.zh: 鸭子在盒子里、盒子上，还是盒子下面？

pages.en: Duck loves to play hide and seek.
pages.zh: 鸭子最喜欢玩捉迷藏。

pages.en: Is Duck in the box? Yes! Quack!
pages.zh: 鸭子在盒子里吗？在！嘎嘎！

pages.en: Now Duck is on the box.
pages.zh: 现在鸭子在盒子上面。

pages.en: Now Duck is under the box. Peek!
pages.zh: 现在鸭子在盒子下面。偷偷看！

pages.en: In, on, under. Duck is everywhere!
pages.zh: 里面、上面、下面。鸭子到处跑！

pages.en: Where will Duck hide next?
pages.zh: 鸭子下次会躲在哪里呢？

synopsis.en: Owl lives up high, Frog lives down low. Who lives in the middle?
synopsis.zh: 猫头鹰住在高高的上面，青蛙住在低低的下面。谁住在中间呢？

pages.en: Owl's tree has three homes.
pages.zh: 猫头鹰的大树上有三个家。

pages.en: Owl lives at the top, up high.
pages.zh: 猫头鹰住在最上面，高高的。

pages.en: Frog lives at the bottom, down low.
pages.zh: 青蛙住在最下面，低低的。

pages.en: Who lives in the middle? Bird!
pages.zh: 谁住在中间呢？小鸟！

pages.en: Up, middle, down. Everyone has a home.
pages.zh: 上面、中间、下面。大家都有家。

pages.en: Good night, tree friends.
pages.zh: 晚安，大树上的朋友们。

title.en: Hide and Seek in the Fog

synopsis.en: In the misty forest, friends hide behind trees and in front of rocks.
synopsis.zh: 迷雾林里，朋友们躲在树后面，还有石头前面。

pages.en: The fog rolls into the Misty Forest.
pages.zh: 迷雾林里起雾了。

pages.en: Yun can hear friends, but cannot see them.
pages.zh: 小云听得见朋友们，可是看不见。

pages.en: "I am behind the tree!" says Owl.
pages.zh: “我在树后面！”猫头鹰说。

pages.en: "I am in front of the rock!" says Frog.
pages.zh: “我在石头前面！”青蛙说。

pages.en: Yun looks behind and in front. Found you!
pages.zh: 小云看看后面，看看前面。找到你们啦！

pages.en: The fog lifts, and everyone laughs.
pages.zh: 雾散了，大家都笑了。

synopsis.en: The bowl goes on the table, and the spoon goes next to the bowl.
synopsis.zh: 碗放在桌子上，勺子放在碗旁边。

pages.en: Dinner time! Yun helps set the table.
pages.zh: 吃晚饭啦！小云帮忙摆桌子。

pages.en: The bowl goes on the table.
pages.zh: 碗放在桌子上。

pages.en: The spoon goes next to the bowl.
pages.zh: 勺子放在碗旁边。

pages.en: The cup goes next to the spoon.
pages.zh: 杯子放在勺子旁边。

pages.en: The rice goes in the bowl. Yum!
pages.zh: 米饭装在碗里。好香！

pages.en: Everything is in its place. Let's eat!
pages.zh: 东西都放好了。开饭啦！

synopsis.en: Up the hill, down the steps, around the pond: Yun follows the path home.
synopsis.zh: 上山坡，下台阶，绕过池塘，小云沿着小路回家。

pages.en: Yun's walk home starts at the big tree.
pages.zh: 小云从大树那里出发回家。

pages.en: Up the hill: one step, two steps.
pages.zh: 上山坡：一步，两步。

pages.en: Down the steps, carefully.
pages.zh: 小心地走下台阶。

pages.en: Around the pond, past the ducks.
pages.zh: 绕过池塘，经过小鸭子。

pages.en: Over the little bridge.
pages.zh: 走过小桥。

pages.en: There is the red door. Home!
pages.zh: 看到红色的门了。到家啦！

synopsis.en: Rain! Yun needs boots and an umbrella. What about sunny days?
synopsis.zh: 下雨了！小云需要雨靴和雨伞。那晴天呢？

pages.en: Drip, drop! It is raining.
pages.zh: 滴答滴答！下雨了。

pages.en: Yun puts on rain boots and a raincoat.
pages.zh: 小云穿上雨靴和雨衣。

pages.en: Yun opens a big umbrella.
pages.zh: 小云打开一把大伞。

pages.en: Splash! Puddles are fun in boots.
pages.zh: 啪嗒！穿着雨靴踩水坑真好玩。

pages.en: Tomorrow will be sunny. Yun will wear a sun hat.
pages.zh: 明天是晴天。小云要戴遮阳帽。

pages.en: Rain clothes, sun clothes. Ready for any day!
pages.zh: 雨天的衣服，晴天的衣服。天天都准备好了！

synopsis.en: One tree through the year: flowers, green leaves, orange leaves, snow.
synopsis.zh: 一棵树的一年：开花、绿叶、黄叶、白雪。

pages.en: In spring, the tree has pink flowers.
pages.zh: 春天，树上开满粉色的花。

pages.en: In summer, the leaves are big and green.
pages.zh: 夏天，树叶又大又绿。

pages.en: In autumn, the leaves turn orange and fall.
pages.zh: 秋天，树叶变黄，飘落下来。

pages.en: In winter, snow sits on the branches.
pages.zh: 冬天，树枝上落满白雪。

pages.en: Then spring comes again.
pages.zh: 然后，春天又来了。

pages.en: One tree, four seasons, all year round.
pages.zh: 一棵树，四个季节，一年又一年。

synopsis.en: The sun goes down, the moon comes up, and the night animals wake.
synopsis.zh: 太阳落山，月亮升起，夜里的动物醒来了。

pages.en: The sun is sleepy. It sinks behind the hill.
pages.zh: 太阳困了。它慢慢落到山后面。

pages.en: The sky turns orange, then pink, then dark blue.
pages.zh: 天空变成橙色，然后粉色，然后深蓝色。

pages.en: The moon comes up.
pages.zh: 月亮升起来了。

pages.en: Owl opens big eyes. Night is Owl's day!
pages.zh: 猫头鹰睁开大眼睛。晚上是猫头鹰的白天！

pages.en: In the morning, the sun comes back.
pages.zh: 到了早上，太阳又回来了。

pages.en: Good morning, sun. Good night, Owl.
pages.zh: 早上好，太阳。晚安，猫头鹰。

synopsis.en: Big ball, middle ball, small ball: Yun and Bear build a snowman.
synopsis.zh: 大雪球、中雪球、小雪球，小云和小熊堆雪人。

pages.en: Snow! Everything is white.
pages.zh: 下雪了！到处都是白白的。

pages.en: Yun rolls a big snowball.
pages.zh: 小云滚了一个大雪球。

pages.en: Bear rolls a middle snowball.
pages.zh: 小熊滚了一个中雪球。

pages.en: Together they roll a small snowball.
pages.zh: 他们一起滚了一个小雪球。

pages.en: Big on the bottom, middle next, small on top.
pages.zh: 大的在下面，中的在中间，小的在最上面。

pages.en: A carrot nose. Hello, snowman!
pages.zh: 插上胡萝卜鼻子。雪人你好！

synopsis.en: Night after night, the moon grows round, then thin again.
synopsis.zh: 一夜又一夜，月亮变圆了，又变弯了。

pages.en: Tonight the moon is thin, like a smile.
pages.zh: 今晚的月亮细细的，像一个笑脸。

pages.en: Each night it grows a little rounder.
pages.zh: 每天晚上，它都变圆一点。

pages.en: Now it is half a circle.
pages.zh: 现在是半个圆。

pages.en: Now it is round and bright!
pages.zh: 现在圆圆的，好亮！

pages.en: Then it gets thinner, night by night.
pages.zh: 然后，一夜又一夜，它又慢慢变细。

pages.en: Round, then thin, then round again. Good night, moon.
pages.zh: 变圆又变细，然后又变圆。晚安，月亮。

synopsis.en: Tracks in the snow! Were they made by Duck, Bear or Rabbit?
synopsis.zh: 雪地上有脚印！是鸭子、小熊，还是小兔留下的？

pages.en: It snowed all night. The ground is white.
pages.zh: 下了一夜的雪。地上白白的。

pages.en: Look! Little marks in the snow.
pages.zh: 快看！雪地上有小小的印子。

pages.en: These are round with tiny toes. A rabbit hopped here!
pages.zh: 这些圆圆的，还有小脚趾。小兔子从这里跳过去了！

pages.en: These are wide and flat. Duck walked here.
pages.zh: 这些又宽又平。鸭子从这里走过。

pages.en: And these big ones? Bear!
pages.zh: 那这些大大的呢？是小熊！

pages.en: Yun makes footprints too, right beside them.
pages.zh: 小云也踩出脚印，就在旁边。

pages.en: Four friends, four kinds of footprints.
pages.zh: 四个朋友，四种脚印。

synopsis.en: A duckling, a kitten, a puppy: each one looks for its mum.
synopsis.zh: 小鸭子、小猫、小狗，每个宝宝都在找妈妈。

pages.en: A little duckling says: Where is my mum?
pages.zh: 一只小鸭子说：我的妈妈在哪里？

pages.en: Yun looks by the pond. Quack! There she is.
pages.zh: 小云在池塘边找。嘎嘎！找到了。

pages.en: A kitten says: Where is my mum?
pages.zh: 一只小猫说：我的妈妈在哪里？

pages.en: Meow! Under the warm window.
pages.zh: 喵！在暖暖的窗户下面。

pages.en: A puppy says: Where is my mum?
pages.zh: 一只小狗说：我的妈妈在哪里？

pages.en: Woof! Right behind the gate.
pages.zh: 汪！就在门后面。

pages.en: Every baby found its mum. Yun goes home too.
pages.zh: 每个宝宝都找到了妈妈。小云也回家了。

synopsis.en: Two long ears behind a bush. Who could it be?
synopsis.zh: 灌木后面露出两只长耳朵。会是谁呢？

pages.en: The forest is quiet. Someone is hiding.
pages.zh: 森林里静悄悄的。有谁躲起来了。

pages.en: Two long ears behind a bush. Who could it be?
pages.zh: 灌木后面露出两只长耳朵。会是谁呢？

pages.en: Peek-a-boo! It's Rabbit.
pages.zh: 躲猫猫！是小兔子。

pages.en: A stripy tail behind a tree. Who could it be?
pages.zh: 树后面露出一条花尾巴。会是谁呢？

pages.en: Peek-a-boo! It's Yun.
pages.zh: 躲猫猫！是小云。

pages.en: Two round eyes up in the branches...
pages.zh: 树枝上有两只圆眼睛……

pages.en: Peek-a-boo, Owl! Everyone laughs.
pages.zh: 躲猫猫，猫头鹰！大家都笑了。

synopsis.en: When Yun goes to sleep, Owl and Mouse wake up.
synopsis.zh: 小云睡觉的时候，猫头鹰和小老鼠醒来了。

pages.en: The sky goes dark. Yun yawns.
pages.zh: 天黑了。小云打了个哈欠。

pages.en: Good night, Duck. Good night, Rabbit.
pages.zh: 晚安，鸭子。晚安，小兔子。

pages.en: But some friends are just waking up.
pages.zh: 可是有些朋友刚刚醒来。

pages.en: Owl opens two big round eyes. Whoo!
pages.zh: 猫头鹰睁开圆圆的大眼睛。咕咕！

pages.en: Mouse comes out to look for seeds.
pages.zh: 小老鼠出来找种子吃。

pages.en: They play all night while Yun dreams.
pages.zh: 小云做梦的时候，他们玩了一整夜。

pages.en: In the morning, they say good night.
pages.zh: 到了早上，他们说晚安。

synopsis.en: Bee visits flower after flower, helping the garden grow.
synopsis.zh: 小蜜蜂飞过一朵又一朵花，帮助花园长大。

pages.en: Bzzz! A little bee wakes up early.
pages.zh: 嗡嗡！一只小蜜蜂早早醒来。

pages.en: She visits a pink flower. Then a yellow one.
pages.zh: 她飞到一朵粉花上。又飞到一朵黄花上。

pages.en: Yellow dust sticks to her legs.
pages.zh: 黄黄的花粉粘在她的腿上。

pages.en: She carries it flower to flower, all day.
pages.zh: 她一整天带着花粉，从这朵飞到那朵。

pages.en: Because of Bee, the flowers make seeds.
pages.zh: 因为有小蜜蜂，花儿才结出种子。

pages.en: And seeds make more flowers. Thank you, Bee!
pages.zh: 种子又长出更多的花。谢谢你，小蜜蜂！

synopsis.en: Apple, key, leaf and rock go in the water. Let's watch!
synopsis.zh: 苹果、钥匙、树叶和石头放进水里。我们看看吧！

pages.en: Yun fills a big bowl with water.
pages.zh: 小云在大盆里装满水。

pages.en: In goes the apple. Splash! It floats.
pages.zh: 苹果放进去。扑通！它浮起来了。

pages.en: In goes the leaf. It floats too.
pages.zh: 树叶放进去。它也浮着。

pages.en: In goes the key. Plop! Down it goes.
pages.zh: 钥匙放进去。咕咚！沉下去了。

pages.en: In goes the rock. Down, down, down.
pages.zh: 石头放进去。沉、沉、沉。

pages.en: What about the wooden boat?
pages.zh: 那木头小船呢？

pages.en: It floats! Yun tries one more thing.
pages.zh: 它浮起来了！小云再试一样东西。

synopsis.en: The sun comes out, and the snowman slowly turns into a puddle.
synopsis.zh: 太阳出来了，雪人慢慢变成了一滩水。

pages.en: Yun and Bear built a snowman yesterday.
pages.zh: 昨天小云和小熊堆了一个雪人。

pages.en: Today the sun is warm and bright.
pages.zh: 今天的太阳又暖又亮。

pages.en: Drip. Drip. The snowman gets smaller.
pages.zh: 滴。滴。雪人变小了。

pages.en: His hat slides down. His nose falls off.
pages.zh: 他的帽子滑下来。鼻子掉了。

pages.en: Soon there is just a puddle and a carrot.
pages.zh: 很快只剩下一滩水和一根胡萝卜。

pages.en: "He will come back," says Bear, "when it snows again."
pages.zh: “下次下雪，”小熊说，“他还会回来的。”

synopsis.en: A little seed needs sun, water and time.
synopsis.zh: 一颗小种子需要阳光、水和时间。

pages.en: Yun has one tiny seed.
pages.zh: 小云有一颗小小的种子。

pages.en: Yun puts it in a pot of soft dirt.
pages.zh: 小云把它种进松软的土里。

pages.en: The seed needs water. Yun pours a little.
pages.zh: 种子需要水。小云浇了一点。

pages.en: The seed needs sun. Yun moves the pot to the window.
pages.zh: 种子需要阳光。小云把花盆搬到窗边。

pages.en: The seed needs time. Yun waits and waits.
pages.zh: 种子还需要时间。小云一直等呀等。

pages.en: One morning, a tiny green leaf!
pages.zh: 有一天早上，长出一片小绿叶！

synopsis.en: The magnet picks up the key and the spoon, but not the leaf.
synopsis.zh: 磁铁吸起了钥匙和勺子，可是吸不起树叶。

pages.en: Grandpa gives Yun a red magnet.
pages.zh: 爷爷给小云一块红色的磁铁。

pages.en: Yun holds it near a key. Click! It sticks.
pages.zh: 小云把它靠近钥匙。啪！吸住了。

pages.en: Yun holds it near a spoon. Click! It sticks.
pages.zh: 小云把它靠近勺子。啪！也吸住了。

pages.en: Yun holds it near a leaf. Nothing happens.
pages.zh: 小云把它靠近树叶。什么也没发生。

pages.en: Nothing happens with the apple either.
pages.zh: 靠近苹果，也什么都没有。

pages.en: Some things stick, and some things don't. Try one more!
pages.zh: 有些东西会吸住，有些不会。再试一个吧！

synopsis.en: When the lamp comes close, Yun's shadow grows big!
synopsis.zh: 灯靠近的时候，小云的影子变大了！

pages.en: At night, Yun turns on the little lamp.
pages.zh: 晚上，小云打开小台灯。

pages.en: Look on the wall! A dark Yun appears.
pages.zh: 看墙上！出现了一个黑黑的小云。

pages.en: Yun waves. The shadow waves back.
pages.zh: 小云挥挥手。影子也挥挥手。

pages.en: Yun steps closer to the lamp. The shadow grows huge!
pages.zh: 小云往灯那边走。影子变得好大！

pages.en: Yun steps away. The shadow gets small again.
pages.zh: 小云退回去。影子又变小了。

pages.en: Good night, little shadow.
pages.zh: 晚安，小小的影子。

synopsis.en: Frog's tower fell down. Frog takes three slow breaths and feels calmer.
synopsis.zh: 青蛙的塔倒了。青蛙慢慢地深呼吸三次，心里好多了。

pages.en: Frog built a tall block tower.
pages.zh: 青蛙搭了一座高高的积木塔。

pages.en: Wobble... crash! The tower falls down.
pages.zh: 晃呀晃……哗啦！塔倒了。

pages.en: Frog's face goes tight. Frog feels grumpy.
pages.zh: 青蛙的脸绷起来了。青蛙很生气。

pages.en: Yun sits beside Frog. "That was your tall one."
pages.zh: 小云坐在青蛙旁边。“那是你搭得最高的。”

pages.en: They breathe in slowly. And out. Three times.
pages.zh: 他们慢慢吸气。再呼气。三次。

pages.en: Frog feels calmer now.
pages.zh: 青蛙慢慢平静下来了。

pages.en: "Let's build it again," says Frog.
pages.zh: “我们再搭一次吧，”青蛙说。

synopsis.en: The thunder is loud. Friends sit close until Butterfly feels safe.
synopsis.zh: 雷声好大。朋友们靠在一起，直到蝴蝶不再害怕。

pages.en: Rumble! Thunder rolls over the hill.
pages.zh: 轰隆！雷声从山那边滚过来。

pages.en: Butterfly shakes. She is scared.
pages.zh: 蝴蝶抖了一下。她害怕了。

pages.en: Yun sits close. Bear sits close too.
pages.zh: 小云坐得近近的。小熊也坐得近近的。

pages.en: "The thunder is loud," says Yun. "We are here."
pages.zh: “雷声很大，”小云说。“我们都在这儿。”

pages.en: They count together: one, two, three.
pages.zh: 他们一起数：一、二、三。

pages.en: The rumble goes quiet. Butterfly feels safe.
pages.zh: 雷声渐渐轻了。蝴蝶觉得安全了。

synopsis.en: One swing, two friends: first Duck, then Yun.
synopsis.zh: 一个秋千，两个朋友：先鸭子，再小云。

pages.en: There is one swing in the garden.
pages.zh: 花园里只有一个秋千。

pages.en: Duck wants it. Yun wants it too.
pages.zh: 鸭子想玩。小云也想玩。

pages.en: "You first," says Yun. "Then me."
pages.zh: “你先玩，”小云说。“然后到我。”

pages.en: Duck swings high. Yun counts to ten.
pages.zh: 鸭子荡得高高的。小云数到十。

pages.en: Now it's Yun's turn. Duck pushes gently.
pages.zh: 现在轮到小云了。鸭子轻轻推她。

pages.en: One swing, two friends, all afternoon.
pages.zh: 一个秋千，两个朋友，玩了一下午。

synopsis.en: Yun bumps Duck's drawing. "Sorry, Duck. Can I help fix it?"
synopsis.zh: 小云碰坏了鸭子的画。“对不起，鸭子。我帮你一起修好吧？”

pages.en: Duck is drawing a big blue boat.
pages.zh: 鸭子在画一艘大大的蓝船。

pages.en: Yun runs past. Oops! The paper tears.
pages.zh: 小云跑过去。哎呀！纸破了。

pages.en: Duck's eyes fill up.
pages.zh: 鸭子的眼睛红了。

pages.en: Yun stops. "Sorry, Duck. I ran too fast."
pages.zh: 小云停下来。“对不起，鸭子。我跑太快了。”

pages.en: "Can I help fix it?"
pages.zh: “我可以帮你修好吗？”

pages.en: They tape the paper and draw a sail.
pages.zh: 他们用胶带把纸粘好，又画上一张帆。

pages.en: Now the boat has a sail. Duck smiles.
pages.zh: 现在小船有帆了。鸭子笑了。

synopsis.en: A shy rabbit arrives. Yun says hello and asks her to play.
synopsis.zh: 来了一只害羞的小兔子。小云说你好，请她一起玩。

pages.en: Someone new is standing by the gate.
pages.zh: 门口站着一个新来的朋友。

pages.en: It is a small rabbit. She is shy.
pages.zh: 是一只小兔子。她有点害羞。

pages.en: Yun walks over slowly. "Hello. I'm Yun."
pages.zh: 小云慢慢走过去。“你好，我叫小云。”

pages.en: Rabbit looks at her feet.
pages.zh: 小兔子低头看着自己的脚。

pages.en: "Would you like to play with us?"
pages.zh: “你想和我们一起玩吗？”

pages.en: Rabbit nods, just a little.
pages.zh: 小兔子轻轻点了点头。

pages.en: By lunchtime, she is laughing loudest.
pages.zh: 到了午饭的时候，她笑得最大声。

synopsis.en: Up and down, round and round: Yun brushes every tooth.
synopsis.zh: 上上下下，转转圈圈，小云把每颗牙都刷干净。

pages.en: After breakfast, it is toothbrush time.
pages.zh: 吃完早饭，该刷牙了。

pages.en: Yun squeezes a tiny bit of toothpaste.
pages.zh: 小云挤上一点点牙膏。

pages.en: Up and down on the front teeth.
pages.zh: 前面的牙齿上上下下刷。

pages.en: Round and round on the back teeth.
pages.zh: 后面的牙齿转圈圈刷。

pages.en: Don't forget the very back ones!
pages.zh: 最里面的可不要忘了！

pages.en: Rinse, spit, and smile in the mirror.
pages.zh: 漱漱口，吐掉，对着镜子笑一笑。

pages.en: All clean. See you tonight, toothbrush.
pages.zh: 干干净净。牙刷，晚上见。

synopsis.en: Socks before shoes, shirt before coat: Yun gets ready.
synopsis.zh: 先穿袜子再穿鞋，先穿衣服再穿外套，小云准备好了。

pages.en: Yun is still in pyjamas.
pages.zh: 小云还穿着睡衣。

pages.en: First, take the pyjamas off.
pages.zh: 先把睡衣脱下来。

pages.en: Then the shirt, over the head.
pages.zh: 再套上衣服，从头上钻过去。

pages.en: Then trousers, one leg, two legs.
pages.zh: 然后穿裤子，一条腿，两条腿。

pages.en: Socks before shoes. That's the rule!
pages.zh: 先穿袜子再穿鞋。这是规矩！

pages.en: Last, the coat, because it is cold.
pages.zh: 最后穿外套，因为外面冷。

pages.en: All dressed! Out the door.
pages.zh: 穿好啦！出门喽。

synopsis.en: Blocks in the box, books on the shelf: tidying is a game.
synopsis.zh: 积木放进盒子，书本放上书架，收拾也是游戏。

pages.en: Playtime is over. The floor is a mess.
pages.zh: 玩完了。地上乱糟糟的。

pages.en: Yun sings: blocks in the box, blocks in the box.
pages.zh: 小云唱着：积木放进盒子，积木放进盒子。

pages.en: Books go on the shelf, standing up straight.
pages.zh: 书本放到书架上，站得直直的。

pages.en: The teddy goes on the bed.
pages.zh: 小熊玩偶放到床上。

pages.en: Bear helps. Duck helps. It goes fast!
pages.zh: 小熊来帮忙。鸭子来帮忙。一下子就好了！

pages.en: Now there is room to dance.
pages.zh: 现在有地方跳舞啦。

synopsis.en: Rice in a bowl, soup with a spoon: everyone eats together.
synopsis.zh: 米饭装在碗里，汤用勺子喝，大家一起吃饭。

pages.en: Something smells good. Dinner is ready!
pages.zh: 好香呀。晚饭做好了！

pages.en: Yun helps carry the bowls to the table.
pages.zh: 小云帮忙把碗端到桌上。

pages.en: Rice goes in the bowl. Soup gets a spoon.
pages.zh: 米饭盛在碗里。汤要用勺子。

pages.en: Everyone sits down together.
pages.zh: 大家一起坐下来。

pages.en: Yun tries a green bean. Yum!
pages.zh: 小云尝了一口豆角。真好吃！

pages.en: "Thank you for dinner," says Yun.
pages.zh: “谢谢您做的饭，”小云说。

synopsis.en: Bath, pyjamas, one story, and a sleepy lantern glow.
synopsis.zh: 洗澡、穿睡衣、听一个故事，灯笼的光暖暖的。

pages.en: The sky is dark. The day is done.
pages.zh: 天黑了。这一天过完了。

pages.en: Warm bath first, with lots of bubbles.
pages.zh: 先洗个热水澡，好多泡泡。

pages.en: Then soft pyjamas.
pages.zh: 然后换上软软的睡衣。

pages.en: Then one story, only one.
pages.zh: 然后听一个故事，只听一个。

pages.en: Yun's lantern glows small and warm.
pages.zh: 小云的灯笼发出暖暖的小小的光。

pages.en: Eyes get heavy. Breathing gets slow.
pages.zh: 眼皮越来越重。呼吸越来越慢。

pages.en: Good night, Yun. See you tomorrow.
pages.zh: 晚安，小云。明天见。

synopsis.en: The whole family folds dumplings. How many can Yun make?
synopsis.zh: 一家人一起包饺子。小云能包几个呢？

pages.en: It is the last night of the old year.
pages.zh: 今天是一年里的最后一晚。

pages.en: The whole family sits around the table.
pages.zh: 一家人围坐在桌子旁。

pages.en: Grandma rolls the little round wrappers.
pages.zh: 奶奶擀圆圆的饺子皮。

pages.en: Dad puts filling in the middle. Fold and press!
pages.zh: 爸爸把馅放在中间。一折，一捏！

pages.en: Yun makes a wobbly one. Everyone cheers.
pages.zh: 小云包了一个歪歪的。大家都鼓掌。

pages.en: One, two, three... a whole plate of dumplings.
pages.zh: 一个、两个、三个……包了满满一盘。

pages.en: Happy New Year! Let's eat.
pages.zh: 新年快乐！开饭啦。

synopsis.en: On the first full moon of the year, the sky fills with lanterns.
synopsis.zh: 新年第一个月圆的晚上，到处都是灯笼。

pages.en: Tonight the moon is perfectly round.
pages.zh: 今晚的月亮圆圆的。

pages.en: It is the first full moon of the year.
pages.zh: 这是一年里第一个月圆的晚上。

pages.en: Lanterns hang all along the street.
pages.zh: 整条街都挂着灯笼。

pages.en: Red ones, yellow ones, one shaped like a rabbit!
pages.zh: 红的、黄的，还有一个是小兔子形状的！

pages.en: Yun carries a little lantern too.
pages.zh: 小云也提着一个小灯笼。

pages.en: They eat sweet round tangyuan.
pages.zh: 他们吃甜甜的圆圆的汤圆。

pages.en: The whole street is glowing.
pages.zh: 整条街都亮亮的。

synopsis.en: Under the round Mid-Autumn moon, Yun shares mooncakes with Grandma.
synopsis.zh: 中秋节的月亮圆圆的，小云和奶奶一起分月饼。

pages.en: Mid-Autumn night. The moon is big and round.
pages.zh: 中秋的晚上。月亮又大又圆。

pages.en: Yun carries a box of mooncakes to Grandma.
pages.zh: 小云带着一盒月饼去奶奶家。

pages.en: They sit outside and look up.
pages.zh: 他们坐在外面抬头看月亮。

pages.en: Grandma cuts one mooncake into four pieces.
pages.zh: 奶奶把一个月饼切成四块。

pages.en: One for Grandma, one for Yun, two to share.
pages.zh: 奶奶一块，小云一块，还有两块一起分。

pages.en: Round moon, round mooncake, round family.
pages.zh: 圆圆的月亮，圆圆的月饼，团团圆圆的一家人。

synopsis.en: Row together! The dragon boat moves when everyone paddles.
synopsis.zh: 一起划，一起划！大家一起用力，龙舟就前进了。

pages.en: Today is the dragon boat race!
pages.zh: 今天是赛龙舟的日子！

pages.en: The boat has a dragon head and a long tail.
pages.zh: 龙舟有龙头，还有长长的尾巴。

pages.en: Bear sits in front. Frog sits behind.
pages.zh: 小熊坐在前面。青蛙坐在后面。

pages.en: Yun beats the drum: boom, boom, boom.
pages.zh: 小云敲鼓：咚、咚、咚。

pages.en: Everyone paddles together on the beat.
pages.zh: 大家跟着鼓点一起划。

pages.en: When they row together, the boat flies!
pages.zh: 大家一起用力，龙舟飞快地前进！

synopsis.en: Fold the paper, cut a shape, open it: a flower with two matching sides!
synopsis.zh: 把纸折起来，剪一剪，打开，两边一模一样的花！

pages.en: Grandma has red paper and small scissors.
pages.zh: 奶奶有红纸和小剪刀。

pages.en: She folds the paper once. Then again.
pages.zh: 她把纸对折一次。再折一次。

pages.en: Snip, snip. She cuts little shapes.
pages.zh: 咔嚓，咔嚓。她剪出小小的形状。

pages.en: Yun cannot tell what it will be.
pages.zh: 小云猜不出会是什么。

pages.en: Grandma opens the paper slowly...
pages.zh: 奶奶慢慢把纸打开……

pages.en: A flower! Both sides look exactly the same.
pages.zh: 一朵花！两边一模一样。

pages.en: They stick it on the window for everyone to see.
pages.zh: 他们把它贴在窗户上，让大家都看见。

synopsis.en: Yun says hello to friends in English and in Chinese.
synopsis.zh: 小云用中文和英文跟朋友们打招呼。

pages.en: Yun goes out to find friends.
pages.zh: 小云出门去找朋友。

pages.en: Here is Bear. "Hello, Bear!"
pages.zh: 遇到小熊。“你好，小熊！”

pages.en: Bear says: "Nǐ hǎo, Yun!"
pages.zh: 小熊说：“Hello，小云！”

pages.en: Here is Duck. "Good morning, Duck!"
pages.zh: 遇到鸭子。“早上好，鸭子！”

pages.en: Duck says: "Zǎo shàng hǎo!"
pages.zh: 鸭子说：“Good morning！”

pages.en: Two ways to say hello. Both mean: I see you.
pages.zh: 两种打招呼的说法。意思都是：我看见你啦。

synopsis.en: Four little hills, flat, up, down-and-up and down, make four different sounds.
synopsis.zh: 四座小山，平平的、往上的、先下后上的、往下的，发出四种不同的声音。

pages.en: Yun finds four little hills.
pages.zh: 小云找到四座小山。

pages.en: The first hill is flat on top. Mā, like a long hum.
pages.zh: 第一座山顶是平的。妈，像长长的一声。

pages.en: The second hill goes up. Má, like asking a question.
pages.zh: 第二座山往上走。麻，像在问问题。

pages.en: The third dips down, then up. Mǎ, like a little bounce.
pages.zh: 第三座先下再上。马，像轻轻弹了一下。

pages.en: The fourth drops down fast. Mà, short and firm.
pages.zh: 第四座一下子往下。骂，又短又干脆。

pages.en: Same sound, four hills, four meanings.
pages.zh: 同样的音，四座山，四个意思。

pages.en: Yun sings all four. Can you?
pages.zh: 小云把四个都唱了一遍。你也来试试？

synopsis.en: Woof or wāng wāng? A dog sounds a little different in each language.
synopsis.zh: Woof 还是汪汪？每种语言里，小狗的叫声都有点不一样。

pages.en: Yun's dog says: Woof woof!
pages.zh: 小云的小狗说：Woof woof！

pages.en: In Chinese, the same dog says: Wāng wāng!
pages.zh: 用中文说，同一只小狗：汪汪！

pages.en: The cat says meow. Or miāo.
pages.zh: 小猫说 meow。也说：喵。

pages.en: The duck says quack. Or gā gā.
pages.zh: 鸭子说 quack。也说：嘎嘎。

pages.en: The cow says moo. Or mōu.
pages.zh: 牛说 moo。也说：哞。

pages.en: Same animal, two ways to say its sound!
pages.zh: 同一只动物，两种说法！

synopsis.en: Cat, hat, bat: words that sound alike make a silly song.
synopsis.zh: 花、家、爸：听起来像的字，唱成一首好玩的歌。

pages.en: Yun likes words that sound the same at the end.
pages.zh: 小云喜欢结尾听起来一样的词。

pages.en: Cat, hat, bat. Listen: they all end the same.
pages.zh: 花、家、妈。听：结尾都一样。

pages.en: A cat in a hat with a bat!
pages.zh: 妈妈在家里种了一朵花！

pages.en: Now try: bear, chair, pear.
pages.zh: 再试试：鱼、雨、雨伞的雨。

pages.en: A bear on a chair eating a pear!
pages.zh: 下雨天，小鱼在水里游！

pages.en: Yun laughs. Silly words are the best.
pages.zh: 小云笑了。好玩的词最有意思。

synopsis.en: An apple is an apple, and also a píngguǒ!
synopsis.zh: 苹果是 píngguǒ，也是 apple！

pages.en: Yun holds up a red apple.
pages.zh: 小云举起一个红苹果。

pages.en: "Apple," says Yun.
pages.zh: “Apple，”小云说。

pages.en: "Píngguǒ," says Grandma.
pages.zh: “苹果，”奶奶说。

pages.en: Both are right! One thing, two names.
pages.zh: 两个都对！一样东西，两个名字。

pages.en: Water is shuǐ. A cat is māo.
pages.zh: Water 是水。Cat 是猫。

pages.en: Yun knows twice as many words as yesterday.
pages.zh: 小云会说的词，比昨天多了一倍。

synopsis.en: Grandma and Yun plant carrots, corn and beans in rows.
synopsis.zh: 奶奶和小云一行一行地种胡萝卜、玉米和豆子。

pages.en: Grandma's garden has long straight rows.
pages.zh: 奶奶的菜园里有一行行直直的地。

pages.en: In the first row: carrots, hiding underground.
pages.zh: 第一行：胡萝卜，藏在土里。

pages.en: In the second row: corn, growing tall.
pages.zh: 第二行：玉米，长得高高的。

pages.en: In the third row: beans, climbing up sticks.
pages.zh: 第三行：豆子，顺着竹竿往上爬。

pages.en: Yun waters every row with a little can.
pages.zh: 小云用小水壶给每一行浇水。

pages.en: At dinner, they eat what they grew.
pages.zh: 吃晚饭的时候，他们吃自己种的菜。

synopsis.en: Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa: every family is a little different.
synopsis.zh: 妈妈、爸爸、奶奶、爷爷，每个家都有一点不一样。

pages.en: Yun draws a picture of everyone at home.
pages.zh: 小云画了一张全家人的画。

pages.en: Here is Mum. Here is Dad.
pages.zh: 这是妈妈。这是爸爸。

pages.en: Here is Grandma, with her glasses.
pages.zh: 这是奶奶，戴着眼镜。

pages.en: Here is Grandpa, with his white hair.
pages.zh: 这是爷爷，白头发。

pages.en: And here is Yun, right in the middle.
pages.zh: 这是小云，就在中间。

pages.en: Every family looks a little different. That's good.
pages.zh: 每个家都有一点不一样。这样很好。

synopsis.en: Yun waters the plants, feeds the fish and folds the socks.
synopsis.zh: 小云给花浇水、喂小鱼，还叠袜子。

pages.en: Yun wants to help today.
pages.zh: 小云今天想帮忙。

pages.en: First, water the plants. Not too much!
pages.zh: 先给花浇水。别浇太多！

pages.en: Then, feed the fish. Just a pinch.
pages.zh: 再喂小鱼。一小撮就够了。

pages.en: Then, fold the socks into pairs.
pages.zh: 然后把袜子两只两只叠好。

pages.en: Yun finds one sock with no partner.
pages.zh: 小云找到一只没有伙伴的袜子。

pages.en: There it is, under the chair!
pages.zh: 在那儿呢，椅子下面！

pages.en: "Thank you, Yun," says Mum.
pages.zh: “谢谢你，小云，”妈妈说。

synopsis.en: The teddy is on the bed, and the ball is under the chair.
synopsis.zh: 小熊玩偶在床上，球在椅子下面。

pages.en: This is Yun's room. Everything has a place.
pages.zh: 这是小云的房间。每样东西都有自己的地方。

pages.en: The teddy sits on the bed.
pages.zh: 小熊玩偶坐在床上。

pages.en: The books stand on the shelf.
pages.zh: 书本立在书架上。

pages.en: The ball rolled under the chair.
pages.zh: 球滚到椅子下面去了。

pages.en: The lantern hangs above the window.
pages.zh: 灯笼挂在窗户上面。

pages.en: And Yun? Yun is right in the middle, playing.
pages.zh: 小云呢？小云就在中间玩。

synopsis.en: In the bath, the boat floats and the key sinks.
synopsis.zh: 洗澡的时候，小船浮起来，钥匙沉下去。

pages.en: Bath time! The water is warm.
pages.zh: 洗澡啦！水暖暖的。

pages.en: Yun brings a little wooden boat.
pages.zh: 小云带来一只小木船。

pages.en: The boat floats. Off it sails!
pages.zh: 小船浮起来了。开走喽！

pages.en: Yun drops in a key. Plop! It sinks.
pages.zh: 小云放进一把钥匙。咕咚！沉下去了。

pages.en: A rubber duck floats. A spoon sinks.
pages.zh: 橡皮鸭子浮着。勺子沉下去。

pages.en: Yun tries everything. What will float next?
pages.zh: 小云什么都试一试。下一个会浮起来吗？

synopsis.en: Boom, boom, tap: the drum parade marches through the village.
synopsis.zh: 咚、咚、嗒，敲鼓游行队走过村子。

pages.en: Boom! Boom! The drum parade is coming.
pages.zh: 咚！咚！敲鼓的队伍来了。

pages.en: Bear beats the big drum: boom, boom.
pages.zh: 小熊敲大鼓：咚，咚。

pages.en: Yun taps the little drum: tap, tap, tap.
pages.zh: 小云敲小鼓：嗒，嗒，嗒。

pages.en: Boom, tap, tap. Boom, tap, tap.
pages.zh: 咚、嗒、嗒。咚、嗒、嗒。

pages.en: Duck joins with a shaker. Shh, shh!
pages.zh: 鸭子拿着沙锤加进来。沙，沙！

pages.en: The whole village marches behind them.
pages.zh: 全村的人都跟在后面走。

synopsis.en: Rabbit hops fast, Turtle walks slow, and both get there in the end.
synopsis.zh: 兔子跳得快，乌龟走得慢，最后都到了。

pages.en: Rabbit and Turtle go to the big tree.
pages.zh: 小兔子和乌龟一起去大树那里。

pages.en: Rabbit hops fast. Hop hop hop hop!
pages.zh: 小兔子跳得快。跳跳跳跳！

pages.en: Turtle walks slow. Step... step... step.
pages.zh: 乌龟走得慢。一步……一步……一步。

pages.en: Yun claps fast for Rabbit.
pages.zh: 小云为小兔子快快地拍手。

pages.en: Yun claps slow for Turtle.
pages.zh: 小云为乌龟慢慢地拍手。

pages.en: Both of them reach the tree. Fast and slow both arrive.
pages.zh: 他们都到了大树下。快的慢的，都能到。

synopsis.en: Bird sings high, Bear hums low. Together they make a song.
synopsis.zh: 小鸟唱得高，小熊哼得低，合在一起是一首歌。

pages.en: Bird sits high in the tree and sings.
pages.zh: 小鸟停在高高的树上唱歌。

pages.en: Her song goes up, up, high and light.
pages.zh: 她的歌往上飞，高高的，轻轻的。

pages.en: Bear sits under the tree and hums.
pages.zh: 小熊坐在树下哼着歌。

pages.en: His song goes down, down, low and warm.
pages.zh: 他的歌往下沉，低低的，暖暖的。

pages.en: High and low, at the same time.
pages.zh: 高音和低音，一起唱。

pages.en: Together it sounds better than either one alone.
pages.zh: 合在一起，比一个人唱好听多了。

synopsis.en: Stand up! Hop like a frog, waddle like a duck, stretch like a cat.
synopsis.zh: 站起来！像青蛙一样跳，像鸭子一样摇，像小猫一样伸懒腰。

pages.en: Put the tablet down. Time to move!
pages.zh: 把平板放下。该动一动啦！

pages.en: Hop like a frog. Hop, hop, hop!
pages.zh: 像青蛙一样跳。跳、跳、跳！

pages.en: Waddle like a duck. Left, right, left.
pages.zh: 像鸭子一样摇。左、右、左。

pages.en: Stretch like a cat. Reach up high!
pages.zh: 像小猫一样伸懒腰。往上够！

pages.en: Stomp like an elephant. Boom, boom!
pages.zh: 像大象一样跺脚。咚，咚！

pages.en: Now sit down and breathe. Well done!
pages.zh: 现在坐下来，喘口气。真棒！

synopsis.en: The lanterns dim, the stars hum, and Yun drifts off to sleep.
synopsis.zh: 灯笼暗下来，星星轻轻唱，小云慢慢睡着了。

pages.en: The day is over. The sky is deep blue.
pages.zh: 一天结束了。天空深深的蓝。

pages.en: One by one, the lanterns go dim.
pages.zh: 灯笼一个一个暗下来。

pages.en: The stars hum a quiet song.
pages.zh: 星星轻轻地哼着歌。

pages.en: Yun's eyes get heavy.
pages.zh: 小云的眼皮越来越重。

pages.en: Tomorrow there will be more lights to find.
pages.zh: 明天还有更多的灯光要去找。

pages.en: But tonight, Yun sleeps.
pages.zh: 但是今晚，小云要睡了。

pages.en: Good night, Yun. Good night, lantern.
pages.zh: 晚安，小云。晚安，灯笼。

synopsis.en: Bear's basket is heavy. Yun helps carry it up the hill.
synopsis.zh: 小熊的篮子好重。小云帮他一起搬上山坡。

pages.en: Bear's basket is full of apples.
pages.zh: 小熊的篮子里装满了苹果。

pages.en: It is heavy. Bear walks slowly.
pages.zh: 篮子好重。小熊走得很慢。

pages.en: Yun sees, and runs over.
pages.zh: 小云看见了，跑过去。

pages.en: "Let me take one side," says Yun.
pages.zh: “我帮你抬一边，”小云说。

pages.en: Together they carry it up the hill.
pages.zh: 他们一起把篮子抬上山坡。

pages.en: Two friends, one basket, not heavy at all.
pages.zh: 两个朋友，一个篮子，一点也不重了。

synopsis.en: Duck's hat blew away! Friends look high and low until they find it.
synopsis.zh: 鸭子的帽子被风吹走了！朋友们到处找，终于找到了。

pages.en: Whoosh! The wind takes Duck's hat.
pages.zh: 呼！风把鸭子的帽子吹跑了。

pages.en: Duck runs after it, but it is gone.
pages.zh: 鸭子追上去，可是帽子不见了。

pages.en: Yun looks up in the tree. Not there.
pages.zh: 小云抬头看树上。不在那儿。

pages.en: Bear looks down in the grass. Not there.
pages.zh: 小熊低头找草丛。也不在。

pages.en: Frog looks in the pond... there it is!
pages.zh: 青蛙在池塘里找……找到了！

pages.en: Wet, but found. "Thank you, everyone."
pages.zh: 湿湿的，但是找回来了。“谢谢大家。”

synopsis.en: The river is too wide for one, but not for friends working together.
synopsis.zh: 一个人过不了宽宽的河，可是朋友们一起就能搭好桥。

pages.en: The river is wide. There is no bridge.
pages.zh: 河很宽。没有桥。

pages.en: Yun holds one plank. It is too short.
pages.zh: 小云拿着一块木板。太短了。

pages.en: Bear brings a plank. Still too short.
pages.zh: 小熊拿来一块。还是太短。

pages.en: Duck and Frog bring two more.
pages.zh: 鸭子和青蛙又拿来两块。

pages.en: One by one, they lay them end to end.
pages.zh: 他们一块接一块地铺过去。

pages.en: Now the bridge reaches the other side!
pages.zh: 现在桥通到对岸啦！

pages.en: They walk across together.
pages.zh: 他们一起走了过去。

synopsis.en: It is daytime and Owl is sleepy. Friends play quietly so Owl can rest.
synopsis.zh: 白天猫头鹰想睡觉。朋友们轻轻地玩，让猫头鹰好好休息。

pages.en: It is the middle of the day. Owl is sleepy.
pages.zh: 大白天的。猫头鹰困了。

pages.en: Owl works all night, so Owl sleeps now.
pages.zh: 猫头鹰整夜都醒着，所以白天要睡觉。

pages.en: Yun wants to bang the drum. But stops.
pages.zh: 小云本来想敲鼓。可是停下来了。

pages.en: "Let's play quietly," whispers Yun.
pages.zh: “我们轻轻地玩吧，”小云小声说。

pages.en: They tiptoe. They whisper. They giggle softly.
pages.zh: 他们踮着脚，小声说话，轻轻地笑。

pages.en: Owl sleeps well. Tonight, Owl will say thank you.
pages.zh: 猫头鹰睡得很好。晚上，他会来说谢谢。

synopsis.en: Every kind thing Yun did made a little light. Together: the brightest lantern.
synopsis.zh: 小云做的每一件好事都是一点光。合在一起，就是最亮的灯笼。

pages.en: Yun has all eight little lights.
pages.zh: 小云找齐了八个小灯光。

pages.en: Red for helping Bear carry apples.
pages.zh: 红色的，是因为帮小熊搬苹果。

pages.en: Blue for finding Duck's lost hat.
pages.zh: 蓝色的，是因为找回了鸭子的帽子。

pages.en: Green for sitting with Butterfly in the thunder.
pages.zh: 绿色的，是因为打雷时陪着蝴蝶。

pages.en: One by one, Yun sends them up.
pages.zh: 小云把它们一个一个送上去。

pages.en: The big lantern glows brighter than ever.
pages.zh: 大灯笼亮得从来没有这么亮过。

pages.en: Every kind thing was a little light.
pages.zh: 每一件好事，都是一点光。

pages.en: Together, they light up the whole hill.
pages.zh: 合在一起，照亮了整座山。
